parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: The name of the protected object that you want to query.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resource-names --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-9lb00005s03 --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aekzd4c0000pdwy --resource example.xxxxaliyundoc.com --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
